claims.claim: runWithAST binds a running read to the file version tracked when the request was scheduled; later edits can invalidate selected operations rather than relabel their result.
Preamble reads intentionally permit older preambles; code completion prioritizes latency and can use stale or absent preamble state.
Compile-command identity changes parser semantics; fallback commands are explicitly unreliable and header commands can be inferred heuristically.
Diagnostics have operation-specific exact/eventual policy rather than one all-versions barrier.
Cross-file information is layered: dynamic open-file index data is combined with slower background/static/remote sources whose coverage and freshness differ.
2017 preamble-storage design explicitly traded memory against speed/storage and made in-memory use configurable rather than universally mandatory.
claims.locator: llvm/llvm-project@e9eb7f0cb815641827fa3d031c38190c10900c14; LLVM Phabricator D39843, especially 2017-11-09 through 2017-11-15 discussion

claims.claim: 2018 background-index scheduling explicitly considered foreground interference and adopted lower-priority background work.
2018 cancellation allowed obsolete reads and intermediate diagnostic updates to be elided.
2020 update invalidation intentionally cancels selected editor-generated operations after later edits rather than forcing obsolete snapshot construction.
2023 asynchronous preamble indexing explicitly accepted temporary stale/partial index-fed results for latency, while preserving lifetime/scheduling safety.
Anneal should model freshness and semantic-model authority independently and assign minimum authority per operation rather than one global ready bit.
Anneal publication/proof acceptance needs exact source+model+environment identity and a publication fence, while navigation/completion-like features may use tagged stale/incomplete state.

limitations: No clangd binary was executed for this report.
Historical review performance numbers were not reproduced.
Review comments record participant rationale and interpretation, not independently verified causal outcomes.
Anneal applicability is derived analysis, not adopted product policy.
